units: <cite ref="Berakhot 20b:17">Ber. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ כדיבור דמי</he> reviewing in mind (a Biblical passage &c.) is as good as loud recitation.

<cite ref="Shabbat 150a:6">Sabb. 150ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 58:13">Is. LVIII, 13</cite>) <he>דיבור אסור ה׳ וכ׳</he> talking (business on the Sabbath) is forbidden, thinking (planning) is permitted.
<cite ref="Berakhot 12b:3">Ber. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ עבירה</he> unchaste imagination, <he>ה׳ ע״ז</he> idolatrous fancy.
<cite ref="Niddah 13b:12">Nidd. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>המביא עצמו לידי ה׳</he> who allows sinful fancies to take a hold of him.
<cite ref="Yoma 29a:1">Yoma 29ᵃ</cite> top <he>הִרְהוּרֵי עבירה וכ׳</he> sinful (obscene) imaginations are more injurious to health than the sin itself.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:1">Esth. R. to III, 1</cite> (play on aḥar) <he>הרהורי דברים היו שם</he> plans (schemes) were there.
